title: Make some noise
slide_intent: Introduce palette choice as a question of the intensity an audience should feel. Placing bright hues in direct contact can lend a message urgency.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can draw on the energy of activist placards and public painting to distinguish its communications.
demonstration: A photograph of a person painting a wall occupies the spread. Pink covers much of the wall, a blue looping stroke crosses it and the painter wears green.
practical_value: Use this as a reference for bold, large-area color when a campaign is meant to attract immediate attention.

content_islands.name: Color chapter opening
content_islands.spec: Place the chapter heading and explanation over the lighter portion of the wall, retaining the rail and folio.

content_islands.name: Painted field
content_islands.spec: Let the pink field and thick blue stroke occupy the broad right side. Keep the painter near the lower-left edge of the field so the scale of the color remains visible.
